cases: TC-1 · AC-1 and AC-3: dimensional weight is length times width times height divided by 5000, and the billable weight is the greater of the rounded weights, not the greater raw weight · billableWeight(lengthCm=40, widthCm=30, heightCm=20, actualWeightKg=3.2) → dimensionalWeightKg=4.8 (24000/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=5.0, roundedActualWeightKg=3.5, billableWeightKg=max(5.0, 3.5)=5.0 kg, not 4.8

TC-2 · AC-2: an exact multiple of 0.5 stays unchanged, and the rounded actual weight can be the greater one · billableWeight(lengthCm=10, widthCm=10, heightCm=10, actualWeightKg=2.0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.2 (1000/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=2.0, billableWeightKg=2.0 kg

TC-3 · REQ-3 and AC-3: both weights are rounded, and the billable weight is the greater rounded value rather than the greater raw value · billableWeight(lengthCm=20, widthCm=20, heightCm=20, actualWeightKg=0.5) → dimensionalWeightKg=1.6 (8000/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=2.0, roundedActualWeightKg=0.5, billableWeightKg=max(2.0, 0.5)=2.0 kg, not 1.6

TC-4 · REQ-2 and REQ-3: a non-exact actual weight rounds up to the next 0.5 and wins over the dimensional weight · billableWeight(lengthCm=15, widthCm=10, heightCm=10, actualWeightKg=2.1) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.3 (1500/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=2.5, billableWeightKg=2.5 kg, not 2.1 and not 2.0

TC-5 · REQ-2: zero is an exact multiple of 0.5 and stays zero · billableWeight(lengthCm=0, widthCm=0, heightCm=0, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0 (0/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.0, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=0.0 kg, not 0.5

TC-6 · REQ-1 and REQ-2: dimensions of one, the smallest positive integer volume · billableWeight(lengthCm=1, widthCm=1, heightCm=1, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.0002 (1/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=0.5 kg, not 0.0002

TC-7 · REQ-2: one step below the 0.5 kg boundary, step 1/5000=0.0002 · billableWeight(lengthCm=21, widthCm=17, heightCm=7, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.4998 (2499/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=0.5 kg, not 0.0

TC-8 · REQ-2: value exactly on the 0.5 kg boundary stays 0.5 · billableWeight(lengthCm=25, widthCm=10, heightCm=10, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.5 (2500/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=0.5 kg, not 1.0

TC-9 · REQ-2: one step above the 0.5 kg boundary rounds up to 1.0 · billableWeight(lengthCm=2501, widthCm=1, heightCm=1, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.5002 (2501/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=1.0, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=1.0 kg, not 0.5

TC-10 · REQ-2: closest producible value below the 0.25 halfway point still rounds up · billableWeight(lengthCm=1249, widthCm=1, heightCm=1, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.2498 (1249/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=0.5 kg, not 0.0

TC-11 · REQ-2: dimensional weight exactly at the 0.25 halfway point rounds up · billableWeight(lengthCm=25, widthCm=10, heightCm=5, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.25 (1250/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=0.5 kg, not 0.0

TC-12 · REQ-2: closest producible value above the 0.25 halfway point rounds up · billableWeight(lengthCm=1251, widthCm=1, heightCm=1, actualWeightKg=0) → dimensionalWeightKg=0.2502 (1251/5000), roundedDimensionalWeightKg=0.5, roundedActualWeightKg=0.0, billableWeightKg=0.5 kg, not 0.0
